title: Number of Foreign Students Who Have Defaulted on Tuition Grant Bond Obligations
what_it_is: Number of Foreign Students Who Have Defaulted on Tuition Grant Bond Obligations

sections.label: International student grant defaulters
sections.summary: The default rate is about 4% over the last three years, with about $5.5 million in grants annually to this group.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: The proportion of defaulters is currently about 4% for the last three years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: The grant amount to this group of international students is about $5.5 million annually.

sections.label: Liquidated damages non-payment actions
sections.summary: Those who fail to pay liquidated damages will face actions preventing them from working or residing in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: For those who fail to pay their liquidated damages, we will also take actions to prevent them from working or residing in Singapore.

sections.label: Tightened recovery of tuition grants
sections.summary: A 4% default rate, about $5.5 million yearly, is now ascertained after contacting nearly all defaulters and tightening recovery.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: Of course, a couple of years have passed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: We managed to contact practically all of them and, therefore, we can ascertain now it is a 4% default rate, representing about $5.5 million a year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: We have tightened the recovery over the last few years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: It means there is no running away from calling them, giving them the right forms to fill at the right time and then also having good border controls.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: I think once we have their names and identity number, they cannot game the system to come back to Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: We will prevent them from working or residing in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: But the fundamental point is still – so long as we believe that we need a suitable proportion of international students in our system and then we provide some tuition grants and scholarships to them, we will expect some of them to default and not fulfil their obligations.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: But we will try to tighten the selection, make sure we pick the right people and make sure that they will continue to fulfil their obligation.
